description.value: Papa John's on McKenzie Avenue is a pizza chain franchise serving Victoria's Saanich area, offering delivery and carryout of pizza, breadsticks, and wings. It is a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the McKenzie Ave corridor who want a hot meal or quick carryout. The location is part of the national Papa Rewards loyalty program.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 6m; stands (8 spaces) at 36m; stands (8 spaces) at 44m; stands (8 spaces) at 47m. Total: 24 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms an active Papa John's franchise at 1632 Mckenzie Ave, Victoria BC V8N 0A3, matching OSM address and phone (778) 749-0800. The site explicitly lists 'Order Carryout' and OSM has takeaway=yes, confirming takeout; no evidence on bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities. OSM opening_hours (11:00-22:40) appears to reflect only carryout hours but the website shows carryout closing at 12:40 AM, a minor discrepancy flagged below.
concerns: OSM opening_hours (11:00-22:40) does not match website carryout hours (11:00 AM - 12:40 AM next day); OSM value may be outdated or recording only part of the hours.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast-food chain with confirmed carryout service; a useful stop for touring cyclists seeking food on the McKenzie Ave corridor.
